caption: The drawing features a large, tan-colored ceramic vessel with a wide circular mouth and a prominent spout angled outward near the top. A thin metal wire handle is attached to the vessel by two small holes near the upper rim. The vessel is decorated with a simple painted blue or dark design resembling a feather or leaf on one side. Placed in front of the vessel and lying diagonally across the bottom of the image is a wooden paddle with a flat, broad end and a rounded handle; a metal ring with a small loop is attached to the handle. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decoration.
title: Batter Jug with Paddle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
